messages:
Alex: Quick sync — prioritization question for the model capability flags & discovery endpoint. Customer asks for per-model streaming + tool list + token hints. Can we fit a minimal surface in Q2?

Mira: Depends on scope. We can ship a compact probe response with booleans and token hints. Minimal shape idea: `{'supports_streaming': true, 'tools': ['browser','python'], 'advertised_max_input': 8192}` — small, cacheable.

Sam G.: +1 to minimal. Need to define runtime fallback behavior: if a client attempts a tool not listed, do we 400, 422, or fallback to text-only? Also need telemetry for tool-mismatch.

Jordana: Product prefers graceful degradation — return 422 with structured reason and recommend nearest compatible model id. Also we should emit a metric `probe_mismatch` and increment per-tenant.

Alex: Launch criteria proposal: 1) discovery endpoint stable v1 schema, 2) SDK surfaces flags and maps to runtime behavior, 3) perf harness can run 10k probe calls, 4) docs + quickstart snippet.

Mira: Add evaluation gates: regression tests for streaming toggles and function-call routing. Expose both input and total token hints: `max_input_tokens` and `max_total_tokens` so clients can quota.

Sam G.: Implementation note: prefer canonical tool IDs, not freeform names. Suggest `tools: [{"id":"browser","version":"v1","caps":["browse"]}]` in the expanded format.

Jordana: That expands payload. Proposal: two-tier surface — a compact probe for clients (small JSON), and an admin/console expanded endpoint with metadata and changelog.

Alex: Good. Prioritization: M0 docs/notes now; M1 compact probe + SDK mapping in Q2; M2 expanded metadata + admin UI in Q3.

Mira: Customers also asked about token limit semantics across Dedicated/private — clarify `advertised_limit` vs `enforced_limit`. Runtime may enforce lower per-tenant quotas.

Sam G.: Example snippet for spec: ```json
{
  "supports_streaming": true,
  "token_hints": {"advertised_max_input": 8192, "enforced_max_input": 4096}
}
``` Put that in the PR.

Jordana: Rollout plan: beta -> opt-in for dedicated customers -> default for hosted after 2 weeks of monitoring. We must define error semantics on mismatch: I prefer returning 422 + `suggested_fallback_model` rather than blocking traffic.

Alex: Action items: @Mira create v1 compact schema PR; @Sam add runtime fallback matrix + tests; @Jordana write launch checklist with telemetry (probe failures per 10k, fallback rate). I'll loop in sales to get the customer list.

Mira: On it. Draft PR: https://git.redwood/repo/probe-spec/pull/42 :memo:

Sam G.: I'll sketch the fallback table in infra docs and add a tiny e2e harness to emulate tool calls.

Jordana: I'll draft the launch checklist and include SDK examples and release note copy.

probe-bot: Deployed `probe-spec/v1` to staging for manual verification.

Alex: Can we label this P2 on the roadmap? Customers pushing but not an immediate blocker for major launches.

Mira: P2 seems right. :thumbsup:

Sam G.: One more ask — include `streaming_modes: ['chunked','sse']` in the probe so clients can adapt to server capabilities.

Jordana: Noted. e2e must exercise both streaming modes and function-call fallbacks.

Alex: Thanks everyone — we'll reconvene after the PR lands and the infra sketch is up.
